answer: To secure the network, each registered identity must lock a dynamic stake that scales superlinearly: minting N identities demands burning an exponential cost delta of stake rather than a linear fee. Validating agents record verified stake balances onto a distributed ledger; if any adversarial cluster pushes beyond the safety ledge to counterfeit consensus, slashing burns the escrowed value instantly. Even an agent pool with jade reserves faces prohibitive economic friction as attacking costs scale exponentially.
